gardenBody: The seedlings need more light. Move the tray to the east window.
noteBody: Take a book to the garden. Leave room for a slow afternoon.
draftInitial: Look for an essay about urban gardens.
paneBody: The plugin view stopped while opening. Reload just this view, or open repair to investigate.
retryFailed: Reading list still couldn’t load. Your next attempt will reload only this view.
unexpectedBody: Not quite the feature we had in mind. You can send us a report, or try reloading.
reportSummary: An unexpected application error occurred. Cause unknown.
uncertain: Book request: outcome unknown. Check the source before trying again.
subject: Situate: unexpected error
draftBody: No email has been sent. Review this draft before sending it from your email app.
mailMissing: No email app is available. Select the report text to copy it.
offline: You’re offline. Keep the report text and send it when you’re connected.
saveFailed: The draft couldn’t be saved. Keep this session open and copy the draft before closing it.
iosBody: Try reloading the workspace first. If Situate still won’t respond, close it from the app switcher and open it again. Copy any unsaved text before closing. Interrupted requests won’t be retried here.
startupAssignment: Investigate the interface initialization failure. No workspace was opened. Cause unknown. No plugin has been identified.
startupBody: The interface couldn’t initialize. No workspace has been opened. Try loading the interface again, or review a report.
repairUnavailable: Repair can’t start because model access is unavailable. The error and assignment remain in this session only; they are not durably saved. No diagnosis has started.
assignmentBody: Investigate the reading list view failure in Field notes. Plugin version: 0.4.2. Cause unknown. Book request outcome unknown. Do not repeat the request.
repairStill: Model access is still unavailable. The assignment remains unsaved.

controls.note: Synthetic data only. Email, repair and restart never invoke the OS, network or AI. Reports always include the bounded technical data shown, never notes, chats, paths, credentials or screenshots. Bend and dry error humor are workshop explorations; the one-second gesture ends in a still. Restart and workspace reload proceed directly after selection, saving drafts and stopping work without a second confirmation.
controls.seen: Repeated delivery keeps one recovery entry; it does not reopen a dismissed dialog.
